_comment: GATE-3D-A1 FREE baselines (reports/2026-07-04-vizdoom-3d-floor-design.md AMENDMENT A1 SS A1.4). 200 episodes each, dtc_gate.cfg, tics=4 fixed, 1000-tic/250-step budget, fresh RNG seeds distinct from the 30 pinned gate seeds (eval/fixtures/gate3d_seeds.json). Measured by tools/gate3d_baselines.py in the vizdoom-world Docker image, 2026-07-03. This file is the scorer's committed R source (eval/score_gate3d.py reads baselines['random']['mean_killcount'] as R) -- pre-registered law, edited only by a reviewed, explicit commit.
_decoy_deviation: spinner is implemented as ALTERNATING TURN_LEFT/ATTACK per step, not A1.4's literal multi-hot 'TURN_LEFT + ATTACK every step' -- core.vizdoom_world.VizdoomWorld.step() takes a single button name only (see tools/gate3d_baselines.py's module docstring for the full deviation note).
_amendment_a2_trigger: spinner clears max(R+2.0, 1.5*R) = 3.375 (mean 3.66) -- per A1.4 this triggers amendment A2 (scenario/threshold re-pin by the orchestrator) BEFORE any paid run. Flagged, not silently absorbed; thresholds in eval/score_gate3d.py are NOT touched by this PR.
